plan.venue_summary: Mohawk's crowd splits between indie and lo-fi (Hovvdy, Kishi Bashi, Weatherday) and loud punk, noise and prog (Geordie Greep, Lip Critic, Show Me the Body). It's a downtown Austin room with a wide, adventurous bill.

recommendations.why: Fans of Brian Fallon and Tim Barry love them, a very strong taste match. They played Austin three times in Apr–May at 29th Street Ballroom but haven't played Mohawk recently. A rising act.
recommendations.routing_note: Played Austin three times Apr–May 2026, none at Mohawk.
recommendations.offer_email:
Hi there,

I'm booking Mohawk in Austin and have been following Good Looks. Fans of Brian Fallon and Tim Barry, who both played our room this fall, clearly love your music, and your run of Austin shows this spring shows the city is ready for you.

We'd love to host you for a headline show on your next Texas run. We'd pair you with Why Bonnie, whose audience overlaps with yours. Could you share your availability and terms?

Thanks,
[Your name], Talent Buyer, Mohawk

generic.why: Their jangly, noisy Chicago indie rock suits Mohawk's room and appeals to Austin's college and indie crowd.
This Indiana shoegaze-pop band is building a fast-growing buzz and would likely draw a sold-out crowd at Mohawk's size.
